scripts.dev:raw: npm run predev && (npm run dev -w @vos/api & npm run dev -w @vos/web)
scripts.dev:web: npm run predev && npm run dev -w @vos/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vos/shared && npm run build -w @vos/adapter && npm run build -w @vos/api && npm run build -w @vos/worker && npm run build -w @vos/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vos/api && npm run test -w @vos/shared && npm run test -w @vos/web
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @vos/shared && npm run build -w @vos/adapter
